long_biography.plain_text:
Darby's operating scale defined Michael Ashkin's business career. The company began with a Brooklyn mail-order catalogue before a second family generation broadened it into medical, dental and pharmaceutical distribution. Ashkin later chaired Darby Group Companies and held controlling rights in its British dental-supply affiliate, marking him as both an active successor and a principal family owner.

The wider group retained its dental, medical and veterinary operations when its generic-drug business was sold in 1993. In 2018, under Ashkin's chairmanship, Darby acquired SmartPractice's dental-supply division, doubled its West Coast footprint and expanded service and distribution facilities. Ashkin described the deal as a continuation of a multigenerational customer-service strategy.

No will, estate record or share-transfer instrument was found, so the precise inheritance mechanics remain private even though inherited-and-expanded is the best-supported origin classification.

Ashkin's chairman title, state-recorded manager role, controlling rights and acquisition statement support Operator as the primary relationship. Public sources do not disclose the division of daily responsibility among Ashkin and other Darby executives.

No strong public source establishes a middle name, exact birth day, birthplace, birth country, secondary nationality or secondary residence. Those fields remain unproposed, and the title field is left blank rather than converting a business role into a personal honorific.

No dedicated Forbes profile or identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, website or other personal social profile was found. Darby Dental's official website is proposed because the company relationship is direct and independently corroborated.
